title: Exact IBM i orderly signoff
summary: Orderly signoff is a separate protected operation. It uniquely matches IBM_I_MAIN_MENU, stages literal option 90, sends exactly one ENTER, then observes until confirmed remote close or changed screen without sending further input.
invariants: Never send 90 based on vague text resemblance.
Staging 90 and pressing ENTER are separate actions.
Timeout, changed screen, pump error or ENTER failure must not be rewritten as successful disconnect.
Service quiesce must precede trusted broker-mediated signoff in the persistent-service path.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
